seeds.scheme: rep: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 6, 0, rep]); threshold pilot: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 6, 999, 0])

summary.note: c_FA = 1, c_miss = ratio, pi* = 1/(1+ratio). fitted = plug-in EM fit on [0, T_train]. Delays only on the target (offline) stream; outcomes are settled counts. fitted_ht_delay plugs the HT state into the cluster continuation (no state-uncertainty integration). state ratios use the true parameters; theory_ratio_naive = E exp(-beta D) holds under stationarity without shocks.

postprocess.what: summary.calibration_by_new_shock and reps[].new_shock added by run_experiments.py --postprocess-e6 (calendars regenerated from the seeds)
